::: {#rem-reed-solomon-list-decoding-source}
#### Efficient list decoding of Reed--Solomon codes

@thm-reed-solomon-list-size says how long the list can be,
but it does not say how to find the list quickly.
@guruswami1999improved gave a polynomial-time algorithm that finds the list for a [Reed--Solomon code](error-correcting-codes.qmd#def-reed-solomon-code).

:::
